description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for the 'Survey' entity, providing methods to fetch active surveys, all surveys, and to find surveys by key considering validity periods.

classes.name: SurveyRepository
classes.description: A repository interface for performing CRUD operations and custom queries on Survey entities.

methods.name: fetchActiveSurveys
methods.description: Retrieves all active surveys valid at the specified point in time.

methods.name: fetchAllSurveys
methods.description: Retrieves all surveys regardless of their validity period.

methods.name: findByKey
methods.description: Finds a survey by its key that is valid at the specified point in time.
